title: Lockfile records an optional dependency that fetches at install time
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry marked optional, which npm may fetch from the network during install. Optional packages still execute install scripts when they resolve, so a failed or substituted fetch can add code paths the review never listed.
remediation: Drop optional dependencies the project does not need, or run installs with optional fetches disabled.
limitation: It matches a package entry marked optional, which npm may fetch from the network during install in the parsed package-lock.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
